// Copied into a fresh starter by the release gate; never shipped in app output.
import { jsonStore } from "@hitslop/svelte";
import schema from "../schema";

if (false) {
  const store = jsonStore({ schema, initial: { count: 0 } });
  const count: number = store.current.count;
  void count;
  // @ts-expect-error Schema infers a number, not a string.
  store.current.count = "one";
  // @ts-expect-error Initial values must agree with the schema.
  jsonStore({ schema, initial: { count: "one" } });
  // @ts-expect-error Count is required.
  jsonStore({ schema, initial: {} });
  store.destroy();
}
